ext_description.message: Fill in the device passwords saved in Lemora (routers, printers, NAS) with one click. Requires Lemora installed on the PC.

link_refused_text.message: Lemora only accepts requests coming from a browser of this user.

popup_pick_entry.message: Pick an entry on the left, or add one with +.

popup_orphan_note.message: This entry has no folder: assign one in the Lemora app. Until it has one, it cannot be edited or deleted from the extension.

popup_copy_password_tip.message: Copy the password (kept out of the clipboard history, cleared after 30 s)

popup_add_this_address_tip.message: Adds $1 to this entry's addresses: the entry will be offered and filled in here

popup_nohost_text.message: Lemora must be installed on this computer (not the portable copy) and opened at least once: it is Lemora that registers the extension in the browser.

popup_closed_text.message: The passwords are in Lemora's database: open it and the extension reconnects by itself.

popup_unpaired_text.message: Lemora will ask you to confirm, showing the browser that is asking. The extension will only see the device passwords of the folders.

popup_locked_text.message: Unlock it in the app with the master password or Windows Hello, then reopen this panel.

popup_confirm_text.message: Every 20 minutes Windows Hello (fingerprint, face or PIN) is needed before showing the passwords.

popup_too_many.message: Too many attempts: try again in 30 seconds.

popup_locked_unlock_app.message: Lemora is locked: unlock it in the app.

popup_pair_text.message: A request appeared in the app: check that the browser shown is this one and approve it. The Lemora window may stay behind: look for it in the taskbar.

popup_waiting_approval.message: Waiting for approval in the app

popup_link_refused_in_lemora.message: The link was refused in Lemora.

popup_none_used.message: No entries used from this browser.

popup_no_login_field.message: No visible login field on the page

popup_pw_copied.message: Password copied · cleared from the clipboard in 30 s

popup_generated.message: Password generated: you see it only here, until you save

popup_fill_fields.message: Complete the highlighted fields: title, at least one user with the password, address and folder.

page_pw_inserted.message: Password entered: after signing up Lemora offers to save it

page_closed_text.message: The passwords are in Lemora's database: open it and try again.

page_nohost_text.message: Lemora must be installed on this computer and opened at least once.

page_unpaired_text.message: Lemora will ask for confirmation, showing the browser that is asking.

page_unlock_text.message: Click the Lemora icon in the browser toolbar and type the master password.

page_confirm_text.message: Every 20 minutes Lemora asks for Windows Hello.

page_locked_text.message: Unlock it in the app with the master password or Windows Hello, then touch the field again.

page_after_login.message: After you sign in, Lemora will offer to save it.

page_other_target_text.message: This form sends the data to another site: Lemora does not fill it in.

page_http_warning.message: Unencrypted page (http): the password travels in clear over the network.

page_covered_text.message: The login fields are covered or hidden by other elements of the page: Lemora does not fill them in.

page_not_for_address.message: This entry is not for this address.

page_confirm_save.message: User $1 on $2. To save it, first confirm it's you.

page_confirm_save_hello.message: User $1 on $2. To save it, first confirm it's you with Windows Hello.

page_confirm_from_icon.message: Confirm from the Lemora icon in the browser toolbar, then press Retry.

page_click_icon_retry.message: Click the Lemora icon in the browser toolbar and type the master password, then press Retry.

page_choose_folder.message: Choose the folder to save it in.
